defect: aiortc 1.11 InboundStream.pop_messages kept start_pos after a delivered message; a deliverable ordered message with a non-contiguous TSN stayed queued and a FORWARD TSN of the lossy pointer channel pruned it, so the ordered qsm-control channel (keyboard, buttons, resize) stalled for the rest of the session while video continued
field_symptom: standalone console over WireGuard, ~120 ms RTT, Chrome on macOS 26.3: keyboard and mouse stopped after 20 s and after 3.5 min; the size after leaving full screen was never sent
fix: aiortc 1.16.0 InboundStream.pop_messages/prune_chunks and FORWARD TSN sequence update, backported in qsm_browser_bridge.py for aiortc < 1.16 (Debian trixie / PVE 9 ship python3-aiortc 1.11.0)

unit_tests.test_sctp_receive: 9 OK with aiortc 1.11.0; 5 OK and 4 skipped with aiortc 1.16.0
